title: Nestle Australia Ltd - proposed acquisition of Novartis Australia's medical nutrition business

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings.

body_sections.Summary: Nestle Australia Ltd proposes to acquire Novartis Australia's medical nutrition business.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On the information available to the ACCC, there appeared to be no significant overlap between the products supplied by Nestle and Novartis in Australia.  Even if a national market for the supply of milk modifiers was adopted, the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition particularly given the small increase in Nestle Australia's market share post-acquisition.
